title: Future Juice Tropical Pineapple  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Tropical Pineapple delivers the sun-drenched taste of ripe Pineapple with an irresistibly juicy bite. Bursting with tangy-sweet flavour, this blend captures the natural vibrancy of fresh Pineapple, balancing its golden sweetness with a touch of tropical sharpness. A smooth, lingering finish enhances the experience, making each inhale taste like a freshly cut slice. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and bold, full-bodied flavour. Perfect for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a bright and refreshing vape. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
